---
title: Analyze mutiple passages from a command-line script
---

Three command-line scripts turn a `#!ctsdata` (CEX) source file into syntax analyses, at different stages and granularities.


## Analyze a corpus from a single command

`analyze_ctsdata_to_files.py`
Use this when there's no reason to keep the segmentation and analysis steps separate.

```sh
python utilities/analyze_ctsdata_to_files.py corpus.cex --output-dir analyses/
```


## Segment the corpus into sentences, then analyze


Step 1:  `tokenize_ctsdata.py` -- segmentation only, no syntax analysis


```sh
python utilities/tokenize_ctsdata.py corpus.cex > tokenized.txt
```


Step 2: `analyze_tokendata_to_files.py` -- analysis only, starting from an already-tokenized file


```sh
python utilities/analyze_tokendata_to_files.py tokenized.txt --output-dir analyses/
python utilities/analyze_tokendata_to_files.py a.txt b.txt --output-dir analyses/
```
